notes.title: Demo v0.2 Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/ccc18f7960650e3339e2e2e0a4481be70c98939b.png"] 

Hello, Animas!

Thank you once again for your continued interest and support for Gigantes Ex Machina.

We’re excited to announce that the demo version has been updated to v0.2, bringing many of the quality-of-life improvements from the main build!


Demo v0.2 Patch Notes


System & Feature Improvements

Key binding customization for keyboard, mouse, and controller input has been added to the system settings.

Auto-aim assist has been introduced to help with targeting during fast-paced combat.

Language support has been expanded to include Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish.

Gameplay Enhancements

Combat balance has been refined for smoother progression and more intuitive difficulty scaling.

A new Arcade Mode stage is now available in the demo, allowing players to experience high-intensity battles and a variety of boss encounters.


v0.2 Hotfix Notes


Combat Mechanism Changes

A laser pointer indicator has been added to help predict the timing of A108 Cyclops’s Gatling attacks.

The performance of A108 Cyclops’s Gatling gun and homing missiles has been nerfed.

The number of smart mines deployed by SN-04 Susanoo has been increased.

The firing pattern of beam cannons used by enemy bosses has been changed, making them dodgeable with boosters.

Reload times for all boss weapons have been increased, creating longer gaps between attacks.

The cooldown time for certain abilities—such as Pulse Charge, Particle Diffuser, Magnetic Field Generator, Artillery Support, Tactical Ballistic Missile, and Orbital Strike—has been reduced.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the effective range upgrade was not being applied.

Fixed an issue where the outline feature in system settings failed to activate after restarting the game, even when toggled on.



Your feedback continues to be a driving force behind the game’s evolution.

We’ll do our best to provide an even better experience.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: v0.2 Hotfix Patch
notes.content:
v0.2 Hotfix Notes


Trait Changes

The Recon trait has been removed and reworked into Reactive Cooling System.

Reactive Cooling System: Booster Regen. up to +50% as capacity lowers

Heavy Armor: Resistance up to +50% as armor breaks



Combat Mechanism Changes

AG-52B Argus base armor adjusted from 2000 to 1800



Hangar Part Adjustments

Reflective Armor: Ballistic Resist. reduced from 20 → 10

High-Capacity Thruster: Movement Spd. penalty removed; now applies Booster Regen. -20



Bug Fixes

Decimal display issue with Battle OS and Weapon Stabilizer has been fixed.

AG-52B Argus no longer gets stuck outside map boundaries.

Nano Crystals no longer consumed multiple times when rapidly clicking locked parts.

Fixed an issue where weapon traits could not be unlocked with Nano Crystals in the hangar.

Controller aim assist settings now save correctly.

Fixed an issue where direct-fire weapons failed to hit the A108 Cyclops.

notes.title: v0.2 Key Binding Update (Now LIVE)
notes.content:
Hello, Animas!

Thank you for your continued passion and support for Gigantes Ex Machina.

The v0.2 update was carefully crafted based on the valuable feedback you've shared with us.

One of the most requested features—key binding customization—has finally been added. You can now freely assign keys for keyboard, mouse, and controller input via the system settings.

We've also rebalanced difficulty levels and weapon performance to deliver a more intuitive and well-rounded combat experience.

Newly unlocked regions, enhanced systems, and a wide range of balance adjustments are detailed below.




v0.2 Patch Notes


System & Feature Improvements

Key binding customization for keyboard, mouse, and controller is now available via system settings.

A new enemy visibility enhancement feature has been added, making it easier to locate enemies on the battlefield. This can be toggled in system settings.

The reward sequence for Story Missions and Arcade Mode has been updated.

Equipment traits in the hangar have been fully reworked for better customization.

Weapon trait customization is now available in the hangar.

Damage values below 1 are now displayed to one decimal place; values of 1 or higher are shown as whole numbers.

Resistance values are now displayed in the combat UI.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/37f51d3b7202089bfc127e7dcd43cfcb4aac721c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/f079ab781b990da3c7874376dcf035e444f67427.png"]

New Missions

Story missions in the newly unlocked regions Atlantis and Asgard are now partially available.

A new Ruins map has been added to Arcade Mode.

After completing regular missions, players can now challenge Assault Missions, featuring increased enemy numbers, faster reinforcements, and higher stats for a more intense experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/6b4041af81759eb0725cb3b329096d35a0a29970.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/d7345215b14ae8429608a4214b9231cebd1031d6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/f8688df572cad4bcf1be2e58437aa6a563673953.png"]

Combat Mechanism Changes

Mission difficulty has been adjusted to be more accessible.

SN-04 Susanoo has received new attack and defense patterns.

AE-113 Aerial has received a new trait: Recon – Base Booster Regen +50%

Weapon & Ability Adjustments

All primary weapons, secondary weapons, and abilities have been buffed to be more effective at lower levels.

The charge attack range of the Railgun has been increased.

Movement penalties during Railgun charge attempts have been reduced.

When AG-52B Argus enters Howitzer Mode, it gains Super Armor, taking damage but becoming immune to status effects.

Item Changes

Auxiliary Tank has been removed and reworked into the Ion Thruster.

Ion Thruster: Enhances booster capacity, reduces energy consumption, and boosts afterburner speed.

Sync Stabilizer: Sync rate now increases by 10% per level.

Rapid Cooling System: Rapidly cools the booster to reduce Quick Boost cost, and recharges faster when booster capacity is below 25%.

New Modules

Heat Pipe: Reduces Booster energy consumption by optimizing thermal transfer efficiency.

Compressed Fuel Cell: Uses high-pressure compressed fuel to efficiently reduce energy consumption during Quick Boost activation.

Graphene Armor: Enhances armor durability and slows damage from repeated impacts.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the Sync Stabilizer's EXP bonus was not functioning.

Fixed a bug where Auto Turrets failed to aim vertically, making it difficult to hit low-flying drones at close range.

Fixed an issue where the ECM Jammer was being displaced by AG-52B Argus’ Ram attack.

Resolved a bug where the camera angle failed to reset when starting a new mission immediately after completing one.

Fixed a display issue in the hangar where weapon stat graphs did not update correctly after switching primary weapons.



You can continue playing with existing save files, but due to changes in reward sequences and new features, some sections may not function as intended.

For best results, we recommend starting with a new save file.

If you encounter issues launching the game, please try deleting your save files located at:
[p align="start"]C:\\Users\\\\AppData\\Local\\GigantesExMachina\\Saved\\SaveGames



We are continuously reviewing and adjusting the game balance to ensure a better experience.

We remain committed to incorporating your feedback and delivering a more polished and immersive gameplay experience through ongoing updates and improvements.



Thank you.

notes.title: v0.1 Hotfix Patch (Updated)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/952db5f638916e189ee1fb478e381c81714f92ca.png"]
Hotfix Notice
We've identified and resolved an issue that prevented progression in story missions.
Please download the latest update to continue playing normally.
We apologize for the inconvenience.


Improvements
Aim Assist Options Refined

Aim assist settings have been further segmented for better usability and control.

Raised Minimum Sync Rate Threshold

The base minimum synchronization rate threshold has been increased to 20.

Shop Price Balance Adjustment

Prices for weapons, items, and abilities purchasable in the shop have been lowered across the board.

Increased Nano Data Acquisition

The amount of nano data obtainable through regular missions and arcade mode has been increased.

Training Mission Failure Display Update

In training missions that allow progression after failure, the result display now shows “Mission Pending” instead of “Mission Failed.”

AE-113 Aerial Balance Adjustment

The tutorial boss AE-113 Aerial’s durability and maximum range have been reduced to improve difficulty balance based on player feedback

AE-113 Aerial Autocannon Upgrade Enabled

AE-113 Aerial’s autocannon can now be upgraded.

Module Price Adjustment

The starting price and incremental cost of modules have been reduced by half. (200 → 100)

Major Reroll Cost Reduction

The starting and incremental cost of rerolling has been reduced to one-tenth of the original. (100 → 10)

Boss Kill Rewards Added

Defeating a mission boss now grants nano data as a separate reward from mission completion.

New Boss Added to Arcade Desert Mission

A new boss, T226P Tempest, joins forces with T205A Stampede for the final battle in the desert mission.

Homing Missile Damage and Lock-On Time Adjustment

Homing missile damage has been reduced, and lower-level missiles now take longer to lock on.

Red Display for Negative Stat Changes During Sync Increase

Negative stat changes on cards are now displayed in red when Sync increases.

Arcade Mode and Archives Reward Update

Nano Crystal is now granted in Arcade Mode and after reading Classified Documents.

Argus Invincibility During Charge Added

AG-52B Argus is now invincible to all attacks during its brief charging motion.

Heavy Units No Longer Knocked Back by Argus

T205A Stampede, T226P Tempest, and A108 Cyclops are no longer pushed back by AG-52B Argus’s charge attack.

Sub-Weapon Damage and Cooldown Buff

Damage and cooldown times for sub-weapons have been increased across the board, making them more powerful and efficient in combat.

Speed Modules and Hangar Customization Nerfed

Modules affecting base movement speed and hangar customization traits have been nerfed to prevent excessive speed scaling and reduce performance gaps between units.

Particle Diffuser now reacts to energy attacks in Auto Mode

The Particle Diffuser in Auto Mode now properly activates in response to energy-based attacks.

Missile truck location now indicated with arrows in Eastern Outpost mission

The missile truck’s position is now marked with directional arrows on the screen in the Eastern Outpost mission.

Leveling up now clears nearby projectiles and grants 1 second of invincibility

Upon leveling up, nearby enemy projectiles are cleared and the unit gains 1 second of invincibility.

Improved aim accuracy for low-profile ground units

Aim assist has been refined to better target ground units with low elevation.

Orbital Strike Nerf

Orbital Strike damage and duration slightly decreased.


Bug Fixes
Objective Overlap Issue

Fixed a bug where triggering multiple dialogues simultaneously could cause two objectives to complete at once.

Arcade Mode Reward Bug

Resolved an issue where Arcade Mode failed to grant rewards. The result screen showed the reward animation, but no actual currency was added.

No Rewards After Retrying with Deleted Save File

Fixed a bug where rewards were not granted even after retrying Arcade Mode with deleted save data.

Stampede Boundary Issue Fixed

Fixed an issue where the T205A Stampede could cross map boundaries under certain conditions.

Aerial Scope Screen Drift Fixed

Resolved a bug where the screen would drift downward while using the AE-113 Aerial scope.

Aerial Railgun Firing Direction Fixed

AE-113 Aerial's railgun no longer fires straight regardless of target position.

AG-52B Argus Resistance Value Bug

Fixed an issue where AG-52B Argus had abnormal resistance values applied.

HX-09A Skyhawk Durability Restoration Bug

Fixed a bug where HX-09A Skyhawk’s durability was restored to 100% during battle in Arcade Mode.

Double Right-Click Required to Go Back After Battle

Fixed an issue where users had to right-click twice to return after a battle ended.

Aim Assist Targeting Error

Fixed an issue where the aim assist system targeted units hidden underground and not attackable.

Voice Mute Dialogue Cutoff Issue

Fixed an issue where muting voice caused dialogue to be cut off prematurely.

Game Freeze on Initial Save File Creation

Resolved a bug where the game would freeze when creating a save file for the first time.

Rocket Launcher and Plasma Cannon Delay Removed

Removed the startup delay for Rocket Launcher and Plasma Cannon.

Boss/Elite Kill Count Not Displaying

Fixed an issue where boss and elite kills were not properly displayed in the post-battle results screen.

Infinite Firing of Artillery Support and Orbital Strike

Fixed a bug where Artillery Support and Orbital Strike would fire endlessly if the caster was stunned during activation.

Enemy Homing Missile Repeated Firing Attempts

Fixed an issue where enemy units using Homing Missiles attempted multiple launches after losing their target.

Sliding After Air Unit Crash Fixed

Fast aerial units no longer slide across the ground after crashing.

Booster Module Application Issue

Fixed an issue where booster-related modules were not applied correctly.

Tactical Ballistic Missile Reload Issue

Fixed an issue where tactical ballistic missiles did not reload immediately after use.

Animation Persistence After Enemy Defeat

Fixed an issue where enemy units continued to play animations even after being defeated.

Plasma Cannon Explosion Failure at Close Range

Resolved a bug where the Plasma Cannon failed to trigger explosions when fired at extremely close range.

Rocket Launcher Trajectory Error

Fixed an issue where the Rocket Launcher would fire directly at airborne units instead of the targeted impact point, causing frequent misses. The Rocket Launcher now fires toward the designated ground impact location rather than directly at the enemy unit.

Enemy spawn issue in the tutorial mission

Fixed a bug where enemies failed to spawn at the beginning of the Tutorial mission.

Projectile freeze issue in Eastern Outpost mission

Fixed a bug where allied projectiles would sometimes freeze mid-air in the Eastern Outpost mission.



If the issue persists, please try deleting your save files located at:

C:\\Users\\\\AppData\\Local\\GigantesExMachina\\Saved\\SaveGames

notes.title: Early Access Release Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/952db5f638916e189ee1fb478e381c81714f92ca.png"]



Hello, this is the Gigantes Ex Machina development team.



The Early Access release, originally scheduled for today (June 25), 



has been postponed to August 5 due to platform review delays and bug issues.



We sincerely apologize for the sudden schedule change and any inconvenience it may cause.


We’ll use this additional time to further polish the game and deliver a more complete experience.



Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: v0.0.2.5.03.017 Update
notes.content:
v0.0.2.5.03.017 Update

Hello, Pilots! It’s been a while since we last greeted you after the Steam Next Fest.

Based on the valuable feedback you provided, we’ve implemented a major update to the demo version in preparation for the Early Access release!

Please check the detailed update information below.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/5133d960e36326f8363e0bdb6251d2b1279c5a73.png"]

System and Feature Enhancements

Xbox controllers are now supported.

Graphics settings can now be adjusted.

Added some UI animations.

A booster deficiency warning HUD has been added.

Defense, destruction, and penetration icons have been added to indicate shield status.


New Mode Added

Complete Regular Operation to unlock Assault Raid.

In Assault Raid, enemy size increases, along with their reinforcement speed and stats.


Combat Mechanism Changes

The auto fire feature for primary weapons has been removed.

Auto fire for countermeasure has been added.

Rotation speed affects the aiming speed at which enemies are targeted.

When using a controller, secondary weapons, abilities, and countermeasure will fire automatically (excluding primary weapons).

When using a controller, enemies near the reticle are auto-targeted.

The experience points gained from enemies have been slightly increased.

Armor stats have been applied to Boss A108 Cyclops.


Weapon and Item Additions/Adjustments

Overall damage for primary and secondary weapons has been increased.

New accuracy feature: Accuracy now affects bullet grouping.

New effective range feature: Damage varies based on distance.

New module upgrade feature: Permanently enhance your mecha.


Item Changes

Repair Nanite: Increase hull integrity by 100 and repair every 10 seconds.

Drain Nanite: Restore a small amount of hull integrity and armor for every 10 enemies defeated.


New Items:

Rapid Cooling System: Speeds up booster cooldown.

Thrust Vector Control: Enhance overall response speed for better maneuvering and evasion.


New Abilities:

Emergency Repair: Repairs hull integrity when used.

Pulse Charge: Releases a powerful pulse energy, damaging and stunning nearby enemies (reward for clearing Regular Operation).


New Modules:

Reinforced Frame: Permanently increases hull integrity.

Lightweight Frame: Permanently increases movement speed.


Other Updates

During level-up, spend a certain amount of currency on the equipment selection screen to refresh available choices.



Additional Language Support:

Japanese

Simplified Chinese

Traditional Chinese



Please note that as the game is still in development, progress data may occasionally reset.

We appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! We’re working hard to deliver a more polished game for early access.

We hope for your continued interest and enthusiasm.

Thank you!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/90d682b02570a5c4320abbb658a704c70dc2dc12.png"]

notes.title: v.0.0.2.4.10.136 UPDATE
notes.content:
v.0.0.2.4.10.136 UPDATE

Dear pilots! 

We hope you are enjoying our demo version so far.

Yes. We heard you! We're grateful that many of you sent us feedbacks!

We've made some changes based on feedback we've received over the past few days.

Please check the list of changes below.

v.0.0.2.4.10.136 Notes

 Added main menu
 Control key guide will appear once when the mission begins
 Added auto fire feature. You can now switch between manual/auto fire mode by pressing ESC
 Added camera zoom by using mouse scroll
 Assault rifle will now fire at a target when it is in the line of fire
 Napalm Launcher will now cause more damage but less frequently
 Flares will now distract enemy missiles a bit faster
 Added missile alert HUD 
 Added camera shake when using afterburner
 Added flame effect when using quick boost
 Added Korean Language

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/3b1a52ae5e47a0282cf253e84e49281586bca353.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186780/c5c77c813ef8b74c7e75fef1c54ed1750b50c7de.png
We are working on more weapons, abilities and items so that you can try out different meta!

October Steam Next Fest is coming soon so we want hear more from you!

Any ideas, feedbacks are always welcome :)

Please wishlist our game if you're interested.

Hope to see you in Early Access soon!

notes.title: Demo version is now available!
notes.content:
Play the Demo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207090

You can now play the demo version of Gigantes Ex Machina!

Just click the 'Download' on the Steam Page.

This demo offers an experience of about 15-30 minutes. 

It consists of a single mission sporting gameplay mechanics such as a randomized power-up leveling system, story sequences and boss battles.

Is the game too hard? Or too easy?
Please feel free to give feedback or any kind of suggestions.

We will do our best to improve what we can :D

You can leave your thought in the Gigantes Ex Machina We need your feedback and opinion! forum.

Found any bug? 
Please report them in the Gigantes Ex Machina Bug Report forum or you can send us e-mail at acrylbyte@gmail.com


We look forward to hear from you!

Hope you enjoy the demo!
